leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure a Vue component with default property values
Apply default props to components that receive no parent data
Initialize component properties with fallback values when props are undefined
Manipulate component behavior by overriding default props with parent-provided values
Construct reusable components that maintain consistent behavior across different usage contexts
Render components with predictable outputs using default property configurations
Integrate default props with Vue's prop validation system for robust component design
